rules.description: Free wait period is 300 seconds (5 minutes)
No-show threshold is 480 seconds total wait (8 minutes)
Wait anchor is corroborated driver_wait_start, matching arrival at 08:43:00. Not generalized Ryde policy.
Free-wait expiry = anchor + 300 seconds. Eligible comparison: elapsedSeconds >= 480.
Free wait and no-show threshold are not added to make 780 seconds. Passing 300 seconds alone does not authorize a no-show cancellation under this profile.
Financial treatment when fee valid: keep existing fee; no additional debit or driver payout.
Financial treatment when conclusively invalid: simulated refund of recorded disputed charge, capped at that charge (500 cents).
